verses.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. How long, O LORD? Will You forget me forever? How long will You hide Your face from me?

xrefs.text: Why do You hide Your face and consider me as Your enemy?
Why have You forgotten us forever? Why have You forsaken us for so long?
How long, O LORD? Will You hide Yourself forever? Will Your wrath keep burning like fire?
How long will the wicked, O LORD, how long will the wicked exult?
For the choirmaster. To the tune of “The Doe of the Dawn.” A Psalm of David. My God, my God, why have You forsaken me? Why are You so far from saving me, so far from my words of groaning?

verses.text: How long must I wrestle in my soul, with sorrow in my heart each day? How long will my enemy dominate me?

xrefs.text: Do not gloat over me, my enemy! Though I have fallen, I will arise; though I sit in darkness, the LORD will be my light.
My sorrow is beyond healing; my heart is faint within me.
Why is my pain unending, and my wound incurable, refusing to be healed? You have indeed become like a mirage to me— water that is not there.
If I go east, He is not there, and if I go west, I cannot find Him.
A joyful heart makes a cheerful countenance, but sorrow of the heart crushes the spirit.

verses.text: Consider me and respond, O LORD my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death,

xrefs.text: But now, for a brief moment, grace has come from the LORD our God to preserve for us a remnant and to give us a stake in His holy place. Even in our bondage, our God has given us new life and light to our eyes.
For You, O LORD, light my lamp; my God lights up my darkness.
While they are flushed with heat, I will serve them a feast, and I will make them drunk so that they may revel; then they will fall asleep forever and never wake up, declares the LORD.
For the choirmaster, to be accompanied by flutes. A Psalm of David. Give ear to my words, O LORD; consider my groaning.
“My father has brought trouble to the land,” Jonathan replied. “Just look at how my eyes have brightened because I tasted a little of this honey.

verses.text: lest my enemy say, “I have overcome him,” and my foes rejoice when I fall.

xrefs.text: in You, my God, I trust. Do not let me be put to shame; do not let my enemies exult over me.
They will fight against you but will never overcome you, since I am with you to deliver you,” declares the LORD.
A man cannot be established through wickedness, but the righteous cannot be uprooted.
He alone is my rock and my salvation; He is my fortress; I will not be shaken.
When the Canaanites and all who live in the land hear about this, they will surround us and wipe out our name from the earth. Then what will You do for Your great name?”

verses.text: But I have trusted in Your loving devotion; my heart will rejoice in Your salvation.

xrefs.text: Surely God is my salvation; I will trust and not be afraid. For the LORD GOD is my strength and my song, and He also has become my salvation.”
keep yourselves in the love of God as you await the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to bring you eternal life.
yet I will exult in the LORD; I will rejoice in the God of my salvation!
But I am like an olive tree flourishing in the house of God; I trust in the loving devotion of God forever and ever.
My soul faints for Your salvation; I wait for Your word.

verses.text: I will sing to the LORD, for He has been good to me.

xrefs.text: Return to your rest, O my soul, for the LORD has been good to you.
Be exalted, O LORD, in Your strength; we will sing and praise Your power.
I will praise You with an upright heart when I learn Your righteous judgments.
